items.lede: Anduril founder Palmer Luckey is vowing to bring computer manufacturing back to the U.S., and by that he doesn't just mean assembly, but every individual component, some of which are exclusively made in China today.
items.title: Anduril, Qualcomm launch BlueChip, a new kind of US-made laptop

items.lede: The defense contractor aims to fully bring back laptop manufacturing on U.S. shores, with its first BlueChip laptop prototypes having 90% procurement cost coming from suppliers in the U.S. and other allied countries.
items.title: Military drone outfit Anduril partners with Qualcomm to build laptops on US soil with new BlueChip venture

items.lede: On Tuesday, defense contractor Anduril and chipmaker Qualcomm announced a partnership to build laptops entirely in the United States, starting with a single model in 2027.
